user.title: Labeled Features
user.description: Replaces the legacy Labeled Feature template sensors with native, byte-compatible sensors. Leave the suffix empty for production; use a suffix (e.g. _dev) to run a validation instance side-by-side with the template sensors.

data_description.entity_id_suffix: Appended to both sensor entity IDs. Must be empty or start with '_' (e.g. _dev).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Labeled Features
reconfigure.description: Change the entity ID suffix. Note: Mode labels live on the sensor entity itself — re-apply any `Mode:` labels to the new sensor entity after a suffix change (or use Mode subentries).

data_description.entity_id_suffix: Appended to both sensor entity IDs. Must be empty or start with '_' (e.g. _dev).

error.invalid_suffix: Invalid suffix. Use an empty value or an underscore-prefixed slug such as _dev (lowercase letters, digits, underscores).

abort.already_configured: An instance with this entity ID suffix is already configured.

data_description.error_mode: How internal errors are handled: silent (ignore), log (Core log), alert (call the alert action), stop (log + Repair issue).
data_description.alert_action: Action called by the alert tier with alert_severity / alert_title / alert_message fields.
data_description.alert_severity: Severity passed to the alert action.

user.title: Add leader definition
user.description: Define a feature leader without labels. Equivalent to `Feature Leader` + `(Area |Floor |)Leader: <Feature>` plus modifier labels. Wins over label definitions for the same entity/feature/scope.

data_description.scope: area / floor / global — equivalent to the Area / Floor / bare label prefix.
data_description.enable_value: Enabled while state equals this value.
data_description.disable_value: Disabled while state equals this value.
data_description.direction: Numeric direction evaluation. Takes precedence over enable/disable values.

user.title: Add Provides declaration
user.description: Declare an area-level Provides feature without labels. Equivalent to an `(Area |Floor |)Provides: <Feature>` label on the area (plus optional Component modifier). Wins over the label declaration for the same scope/label.

data_description.scope: area / floor / none — equivalent to the Area / Floor / bare label prefix.
data_description.component: Component hint recorded in label_map (default select).

user.title: Add feature mode
user.description: Set the fold mode for a (feature, scope) pair without labels. Equivalent to a `<Scoped Feature> Mode: Leader|Any|All` label on the sensor entity. Wins over the label.

data_description.mode: leader = only the triggering leader counts; any = OR over all mapped leaders; all = AND over all mapped leaders.

set_feature.name: Set Feature
set_feature.description: Write a manual override into the features attribute of the default instance's state sensor.

target_feature.name: Target Feature
target_feature.description: The feature name whose state to write (e.g. Night).

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: The scope the override applies to.

scope_id.name: Scope ID
scope_id.description: The area_id or floor_id; empty for global scope.

set_snapshot.name: Set Snapshot
set_snapshot.description: Write (or clear) an entry under the snapshots attribute of the default instance's state sensor.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: The mapping payload to store. Empty mapping clears the entry.

handle_error.name: Handle Error
handle_error.description: Route an error through the Labeled Features error tiers (field-compatible with script.labeled_feature_error_mode).

error_mode.name: Error Mode
error_mode.description: Error handling tier: silent, log, alert, or stop.

source.name: Source
source.description: Short label for the error source.

leader_no_area.title: Leader without an area
leader_no_area.description: {source}: {message} Assign the entity (or its device) to an area, or change the leader's scope. This issue clears itself once resolved.

leader_no_floor.title: Leader without a floor
leader_no_floor.description: {source}: {message} Assign the entity's area to a floor, or change the leader's scope. This issue clears itself once resolved.

provides_no_floor.title: Provides declaration without a floor
provides_no_floor.description: {source}: {message} Assign the area to a floor, or change the declaration's scope. This issue clears itself once resolved.

invalid_subentry.title: Invalid Labeled Features subentry
invalid_subentry.description: {source}: {message} Edit or remove the offending subentry from the integration card.

alert_action_failed.title: Labeled Features alert action failed
alert_action_failed.description: {source}: {message} Check the configured alert action under the integration's options.

no_default_instance.title: No default Labeled Features instance
no_default_instance.description: This action writes to the default (suffix-less) instance, which is not currently loaded.

no_default_instance.message: No default (suffix-less) Labeled Features instance is loaded. This action writes only to the default instance.
